exp_1.title: System Development Technician

exp_3.title: Junior Software Developer

proj_1.title: Math Calculations
proj_1.desc: Math Calculations is a React SPA (built with Create React App), designed as a portfolio project. It works as a calculator hub: the user navigates through Math, Physics, BMI, and Interest routes, each with its own operation and result screen, plus About and Contact pages. Deployed on Vercel.

proj_2.title: Anime & Manga Info
proj_2.desc: Anime & Manga Info is a React SPA that consumes the public Kitsu API to display anime and manga catalogs. It features a home screen to choose between anime/manga, a content page with carousels (popular, top rated, current season, recent), genre-based search, a details page, and a contact screen. Deployed on Vercel.

proj_3.title: Library CRUD
proj_3.desc: Library CRUD is a full-stack book registration project, styled as a library system. Backend built with Spring Boot, exposing a REST API (/livraria) with MySQL persistence via JPA; frontend built with React consuming that API. No live demo — the repository runs locally (backend + MySQL + frontend, run separately).

proj_4.title: TSAuth
proj_4.desc: TSAuth is a portfolio project focused on user authentication: sign-up, login, account update, and account deletion, with a protected route (/user). Backend built with Node.js + Express + MongoDB (Mongoose), JWT-based authentication; frontend built with React + Vite, both 100% TypeScript. Design inspired by the 'Logify' Figma kit.
